description: PROPOSED (issue #107 / Discussion #108, not yet normative): Strict validation of a suite: a suite-level `threshold` (a real gap reported in ChelseaKR/gauntlet#76 -- suites have no threshold field), unknown keys in `config` and `config.retry`, and an unknown key on a TestCase are each rejected with UNKNOWN_FIELD. error_paths lists the suite-level paths only; the reference validators report the nested TestCase error with their existing "$.test_cases[0]." + "$.<field>" prefixing.
